default.irrigation: Irrigate at critical stages (flowering, filling); avoid waterlogging.
default.nutrients: Split nitrogen into 2-3 doses; apply full P and K as basal dose.
default.pests: Scout weekly; use IPM (traps, neem-based sprays) before chemicals.
default.weather: Watch forecasts: delay spraying/irrigation before heavy rain.
default.weeds: Weed at 20 and 40 days after sowing; mulch where possible.

rice.irrigation: Keep 2-5 cm standing water during vegetative stage; drain 10 days before harvest.
rice.pests: Watch for blast, brown planthopper and stem borer.

cotton.pests: Monitor bollworm and whitefly with pheromone/sticky traps.
